packageRules.description: Base and tool images are pinned by digest so a rebuild resolves to the same bytes.
dspy-ai 2.4.9 is what the fork in src/kvasir/storm was written against, and its API changed substantially afterwards. Raising it is a project, not a dependency bump.
sentence-transformers is pinned because the resolver otherwise picks a version incompatible with modern huggingface-hub. Raising it needs checking by hand.
torch comes from the PyTorch CPU index rather than PyPI, and only exists to keep the CUDA runtime out of the image.
